lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: Hey- hey! It's us! It's us!
lines.direction: shouting after someone running away in the dark, trying to stop her bolting

lines.speaker: nurse
lines.direction: a sharp frightened gasp first, then recognition and relief breaking through; the second "Tomas" is almost a sob

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: It's me. Come to the door.
lines.direction: raised to carry through thick glass; steady, practised calm with tension underneath

lines.speaker: nurse
lines.text: I'm sorry- I saw the guns, I thought you were-
lines.direction: breathless and apologetic, words tumbling out, cutting herself off

lines.speaker: medic
lines.direction: gentle but firm, raised to carry through glass

lines.speaker: nurse
lines.text: It locked. When I shut it, it just- locked.
lines.direction: disbelief rising into panic, pushing at a door that will not move

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Hang on. ...Admin's sealed the medical deck. Remotely. I can't touch it from here.
lines.direction: first two words busy at a keyboard, then reading a screen and the realisation landing; quiet anger, no humour at all

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: I can give you the intercom.
lines.direction: offering the only thing he has, apologetic, subdued

lines.speaker: nurse
lines.direction: small and shaky, close to a microphone

lines.speaker: medic
lines.direction: steady and reassuring, tension under it

lines.speaker: medic
lines.direction: a doctor triaging: calm clinical orders, a short beat between the two

lines.speaker: medic
lines.direction: clinical and careful, dread just under the calm

lines.speaker: nurse
lines.text: No. I hid. I just hid.
lines.direction: shaky and tearful, trying to be brave for him

lines.speaker: medic
lines.direction: the first said to her, reassuring; the second quieter, said to himself

lines.speaker: nurse
lines.text: It's in the surgery. It's been in there since the lights went.
lines.direction: a frightened whisper, as if something in the next room could hear

lines.speaker: nurse
lines.direction: barely audible, terrified

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: Look at me. Not the door. Me.
lines.direction: low and tense, holding himself together, firm and slow

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: Back to the wall. By the beds. Sit. ...That's medical advice.
lines.direction: tense calm orders; after a pause the last sentence is gentle, close to breaking

lines.speaker: nurse
lines.direction: a nervous, shaking laugh through tears that falls apart into a sob before the line ends; not amused

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Armory's on its own circuit. That one I can open.
lines.direction: flat and focused, no humour

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.direction: quiet and grim

lines.speaker: nurse
lines.text: I made you a coffee. Before. It's still on the counter.
lines.direction: small and wistful, holding herself together

lines.speaker: medic
lines.direction: soft and steady

lines.speaker: nurse
lines.direction: almost a laugh, tearful

lines.speaker: medic
lines.direction: soft, warm and firm, a promise

lines.speaker: medic
lines.direction: flat and hollow, worn out, pulling himself together; quiet, not for anyone

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: I told her she was fine.
lines.direction: flat, quiet and hollow

lines.speaker: medic
lines.direction: quiet, after a long silence; purely functional

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: I can't- Tomas, I can't override it!

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: Easy. Stay tight—I don't know this section.
lines.direction: hushed, tense whisper in a dark unfamiliar industrial room; weapon up, watching the shadows

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Yeah. Eyes open—I can't see the far wall.
lines.direction: low, guarded whisper answering Okafor; scanning the dark bay

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Relax, you two. It's just the lower power bay. I've been down here a hundred times.
lines.direction: casual, unbothered, walking right past their tense whispering; warm dry amusement

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Let's see why the transit rail's dead... breakers are fine, bus pressure's holding...
lines.direction: muttering to himself while tapping the console, focused engineer diagnosing a fault

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Ha—there it is! Quarantine dumped the phase relays. Lazy lockout. Watch this.
lines.direction: sudden bright a-ha realization, pleased with himself, reaching for the switches

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.direction: steady, satisfied callout over the first low generator rumble starting up

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Phase two. Rail bus taking load.
lines.direction: brisk, confident over the deepening generator hum

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.direction: warm satisfaction as the final overhead banks stabilize

lines.speaker: medic
lines.text: North bulkhead just cycled. That lead to the train?
lines.direction: normal speaking volume, clear steady relieved voice, not whispering, glancing toward the open north doorway

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Straight through the maintenance hall. Departure bay's on the other side—let's move.
lines.direction: brisk, ready to go, gesturing north toward the maintenance corridor
